New Device Filter

Change the new device filter to control how ZTPF finds new devices in FMG. If FMG has lots of devices it is better to decrease the scope of the search criteria into the device database.

 

All:

The default and will search the entire DVMDB Database in FMG to look for devices that we do not have device records.

 

Unauthorized:

Only finds devices that are in the root ADOM and Unauthorized.

 

Custom Filters:

Refer to the FMG API documentation for how to leverage the following operators.

Custom Filters:

Refer to the FMG API documentation for how to leverage the following operators.

Operator # of target(s) Descriptions
"==" 1 Equal to
"!=" 1 Not equal to
"<" 1 Less than
"<=" 1 Less than or equal to
">" 1 Greater than
">=" 1 Greater than or equal to
"&" 1 Bitwise AND, target can be integer value only, test if (source & target) = 0
"&" 2 Bitwise AND, target can be integer value only, test if (source & target1) = target2
"in" 1 or more Test if source is one of the values in target
"contain" 1 If source have a list of values, test if it contains target
"like" 1 SQL pattern matching, where target is a string using % (any character) and _ (single character) wildcard
"!like" 1 Not like, inverse of "like" operation
"glob" 1 Case-sensitive pattern matching with target string using UNIX wildcards
"!glob" 1 Not glob, inverse of "glob" operation
"&&" 1 Logical AND operator for nested filter with multiple criteria, where source and target must be another filter
"||" 1 Logical OR operator for nested filter with multiple criteria, where source and target must be another filter

 

Examples:

 ["name","==","FG1"]

 ["name","==","FG1"],"||",["name","==","FG2"]
